limitations: Static imports only; dynamic computed paths remain unresolved.
Store methods and $ auto-subscriptions are indexed; arbitrary helper/mutable aliases may escape analysis.
IPC payload types are explicit contracts when available; untyped endpoints keep source expressions.
Settings property paths with computed keys use *; store reads also index whole settings values.
Window reachability is an upper bound across conditional branches; preview is embedded.
Numeric timings are evaluated only for literals and simple constant arithmetic; null means dynamic, not zero.
